Please, comment on this post if you still find any.

notes.title: Bug in the latest update fixed!
notes.notes:
Thanks to the quick and helpful Steam support, the bug we found last week when updating the game is now fixed!

So the German version now works fine and there shouldn't be any issue with the CG gallery. If everything goes well, the Spanish version will be added next week  ;)

Please, report if you find any other bug; especially with Mac, since none of my team members are Mac users.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
German translation and missing achievements fixed!

Please, leave me a comment on this post if you still find these issues (especially if you play on Mac, since I can't test Mac builds myself). 

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Full Voice Acting Update
notes.notes:
Full voice acting in English added at last!

I apologize for the delay: one of the main VAs was sick for weeks and couldn't force his throat, and we had to replace the sound editor at the last moment. All in all, a bit stressful, but I think the outcome is worth it! Please download again your game and check it out for yourself!

notes.title: German version now available!
notes.notes:
You can now play My Burning Heart in German!

The game's Steam page has been also translated. Look forward to the Spanish and French translations!

notes.title: Updated Release date
notes.notes:
Hi, guys! 

I know some of you are impatient to get the full version of My Burning Heart ːsteamhappyː Sadly, some details are yet to be finished, like text proofreading, Steam achievements and such, so we are going to push the release date a little bit.

The new (and final) release date is July 19th!

Thank you for your patience and your continued support! <3
